integrity: Finite generating-function identities were proved by graph inversion and checked by exact integer polynomial algebra; direct finite enumeration is corroboration only. No external validation has been performed.
limitations: Counts distinct exact unordered contiguous pair-composition observations. It does not determine fiber sizes, decoding complexity or noisy-channel performance. The all-alphabet asymptotic takes length to infinity at fixed alphabet size. Previously unindexed equivalent enumerations remain possible.
title: A parity threshold in two-letter composition spectra
